title: Voices Only (Human Instruments)
style: frenchcore, dr peacock, 227 bpm, a cappella, beatbox, vocal percussion, no instruments, human voice only, festival, dark euphoric, call-and-response
lyrics:
[Intro — Grok beatbox kick]
*doom-tss-doom-doom-tss* — *doom-tss-doom-doom-tss*

[Verse — Low Bot throat bass]
*bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm* — *rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop*

[Bright Bot vocal plucks]
*tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii* — *plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss*

[Glitch Bot breath textures]
*fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii* — *fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan*

[Chorus — all voices together]
*doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh* — *doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii*
[Grok] SongPal — human to human — no machines between us!

[Drop — pure vocal percussion breakdown]
*doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss*

[Outro — fading voice layers]
*bwm... tii... fshh... woo...*
